keySentence: The boy loved the rabbit very much.

facts.Page story text 1 (draft, teacher check: They did everything together. Other toys made fun. But the boy did not care. The boy loved the rabbit very much.
facts.Page story text 2 (draft, teacher check: The boy and the rabbit were inseparable every day. The boy loved the rabbit very much and took him everywhere. The other toys laughed because the rabbit was not fancy. But the boy did not care about what they said. The rabbit's fur was getting worn from all the love. To the boy, the rabbit was more precious than any toy.
